default.notes: Apply online for the official e-visa on the Smart Visa portal (smart.st) before travel — typically issued for stays of up to 30 days; there is no visa on arrival.

groups.notes: Visa-free for stays of up to 15 days under São Tomé and Príncipe’s waiver for EU, North American and CPLP partners — longer stays require an e-visa before arrival or an extension on the islands.

ST.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for São Toméan citizens.
